newsitem.title: USA: Xilinx sees Q2 net, revs below Q1.
newsitem.headline: Xilinx sees Q2 net, revs below Q1.

text.p: Xilinx Inc on Monday said it expects net income and revenue for the second quarter ending September 28 to be below the levels posted in the first quarter.
In a statement, the company said it expects revenues to be about 12 to 13 percent below the first quarter level of $150.2 million.

It said operating income, before a $5 million pre-tax, non-recurring charge related to the discontinuation of the company's antifuse technology, would be between $33 and $35 million. The provider of programmable logic devices reported operating profits of $49.5 million in the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
The company said net income before the write-off is expected to be $22 to $24 million, or about $0.30 a share, versus a profit of $32.5 million, or $0.41 a share, in the first quarter.

According to First Call, analysts expected the company to report a profit for the second quarter of fiscal 1997 of $0.38 a share. Xilinx reported second quarter profits a year ago of $28.8 million or $0.37 a share on revenues of $141.2 million.
